title: U.S. Producer Inflation Hits Four-Year High as Iran War Drives Energy Costs Up
author: James O'Connor
excerpt: U.S. producer prices recorded their largest monthly increase in four years as the Iran conflict pushed oil and shipping costs higher, intensifying inflation concerns.

title: Michael Barr Warns Private Credit Risks Could Trigger Broader Financial Stress
author: Michael Chen
excerpt: Federal Reserve official Michael Barr warns that risks in the fast-growing private credit market could trigger broader financial stress and a potential credit crunch.

title: US Economy Slows to 1.4% Growth as Shutdown and Weak Spending Weigh on GDP
author: Alex Thorne
excerpt: US GDP grew just 1.4% in Q4 as a government shutdown and weaker consumer spending slowed the economy, complicating the Federal Reserve’s interest rate outlook.

title: Tesla Q1 Earnings Beat Expectations Amid Rising Competition
author: Maria Sanchez
excerpt: Tesla reports strong Q1 2026 earnings with rising revenue, but faces growing competition from BYD and increased spending on AI and robotics.

title: NextEra Energy to Acquire Dominion Energy in $67 Billion AI-Powered Utility Deal
author: David Smith
excerpt: NextEra Energy will acquire Dominion Energy in a $67 billion merger driven by soaring AI-related electricity demand from data centers and cloud computing infrastructure.

title: Byron Allen Takes Control of BuzzFeed in $120 Million Deal
author: Sarah Wu
excerpt: Media entrepreneur Byron Allen reached a deal to acquire a controlling stake in BuzzFeed in a $120 million agreement, reshaping the digital media company as it pivots toward AI, streaming, and creator-focused content.

title: The Retirement Crisis Reimagined: AI-Driven Personalized Wealth Management
author: David Smith
excerpt: Individual financial advice is being democratized in 2026 through AI-driven 'Financial Copilots' that act as lifelong personal CFOs for the average worker...
